Alger, 24 octobre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, October 24, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Algérie Poste and Air Algérie Cargo have signed a framework agreement aimed at structuring their collaboration and developing integrated services, covering the digital and logistics sectors.
Accord-cadre pour une synergie logistiqu: Framework agreement for enhanced logistics and digital synergy
Algérie Poste et Air Algérie Cargo ont o: Algérie Poste and Air Algérie Cargo have formalized, during an official ceremony, a framework agreement designed to harmonize their efforts and innovate in the services offered to economic players. This commitment is part of a momentum to modernize postal and logistics infrastructures, aligned with the challenges of the digital shift in Algeria.
Les axes prioritaires de cette collabora: The priority areas of this collaboration concern several key domains: electronic payment services, financial solutions and banking products, as well as proximity services. Furthermore, the agreement also covers the air transport of mail and parcels, logistics operations, and associated commercial services. These initiatives aim to meet the growing needs of businesses and optimize the user experience.
